newsitem.title: KENYA: 11 killed in landslip in central Kenya.
newsitem.headline: 11 killed in landslip in central Kenya.

text.p: Eleven people were killed when buried by soil loosened by heavy rains in the key Kenyan coffee growing region of Murang'a, Nairobi newspapers reported on Thursday.

The Daily Nation newspaper said three other people were seriously injured in the Wednesday accident. Soil slid more than 800 metres (yards) and buried several homesteads, according to newspaper accounts.
In 1991 eight people were killed in a landslip after a storm in the district.
